projects.title: The Huthut
projects.summary: Editorial architectural and lifestyle photography capturing organic wooden craftsmanship, open pavilions, and tranquil nature surroundings.
projects.description: A celebration of sustainable bamboo architecture and open-air living nestled among lush coastal hills.
projects.content:
## Overview

The Huthut is a sustainable eco-retreat conceived as an organic cluster of bamboo and reclaimed timber pavilions nestled into the coastal hillsides of Lombok.

## Craftsmanship & Architecture

The visual documentation focused on the tactile qualities of handmade joinery, curved structural bamboo columns, and high vaulted ceilings that allow natural sea breezes to circulate through the living quarters.

- **Organic Structures**: Handcrafted sustainable materials with rhythmic geometric curves.
- **Biophilic Living**: Seamless openness blurring boundary lines between the jungle and interior spaces.
- **Warm Illumination**: Low-impact ambient lighting highlighting the warm amber hues of aged teak and rattan.

## Visual Narrative

Framing the tactile dialogue between traditional artisan building techniques and contemporary eco-luxury living, the photography provides an intimate exploration of form, texture, and light.

projects.title: Bali Paradise Suites
projects.summary: Hospitality and property visual capture highlighting boutique luxury suites, sunlit private pools, and elegant interior design.
projects.description: Documenting high-end hospitality interiors, intimate plunge pools, and seamless indoor-outdoor transitions.
projects.content:
## Overview

Bali Paradise Suites represents the intersection of boutique luxury hospitality and relaxed tropical living. Situated in Canggu, each suite is oriented around private sunlit courtyards and reflection pools.

## Light & Hospitality Experience

The photography captures the serene morning ambiance as soft daylight washes over custom terrazzo floors and brass architectural fixtures.

- **Private Courtyards**: Turquoise plunge pools reflecting minimalist plaster facades.
- **Material Palette**: Custom terrazzo, microcement, brass accents, and woven textiles.
- **Guest Experience**: Editorial vignettes evoking effortless relaxation and quiet refinement.

## Visual Narrative

Through balanced compositions and natural framing, the visual series highlights the spatial intimacy and luxury hospitality standards that define the property.
